dataset.policy: per-chunk pgbench -i -s 10, CHECKPOINT + VACUUM (ANALYZE) before each measured block, bloat accounting per chunk

pooler_config:
# pgcat M1 baseline (transaction mode, file: pgcat.toml)
# refs: CONFIG.md, README.md, pgcat.toml example
[general]
host = "0.0.0.0"
port = 6436
connect_timeout = 1000
idle_timeout = 30000
server_lifetime = 86400000
worker_threads = 5
# admin console credentials (CONFIG.md: general.admin_username
# / admin_password are required fields; CI-only values)
admin_username = "pgcat_admin"
admin_password = "pgcat_admin_pass"

[pools.benchdb]
pool_mode = "transaction"
load_balancing_mode = "random"
default_role = "any"
query_parser_enabled = true
primary_reads_enabled = true
prepared_statements_cache_size = 0

[pools.benchdb.users.0]
username = "benchuser"
password = "benchpass"
pool_size = 10
# single-shard layout (CONFIG.md pools.<pool>.shards.<idx>:
# servers are [host, port, role] triples, database selects
# the backend database; one primary shard, no replicas)

[pools.benchdb.shards.0]
servers = [ ["127.0.0.1", 5432, "primary"] ]
database = "benchdb"
